name: How much does professional mildew smell removal cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does professional mildew smell removal cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional mildew smell removal, which often involves mold remediation, varies significantly based on several factors. These include the size of the affected area, the extent of mold growth, the type of mold, and the accessibility of the contaminated spaces. Minor issues might range from a few hundred dollars, while extensive mold in hard-to-reach areas, like HVAC systems or behind walls, can cost several thousand. It's best to get an on-site inspection and detailed estimate from a restoration company, as they can accurately assess the scope of work needed.
